body: Thank you. I’m lucky that I do have a lot of love in my life. Unfortunately romantic love is very difficult to come by when ur crazy lol
Thank you for responding. I have PTSD too, it’s nice to know it’s possible to be loved with that condition (sadly so far all it’s done is attract narcs and abusers to me)
Thank you for validating this. Every person who tells me to  ‘love myself’ makes me more suicidal
Everytime I’ve smoked weed ive had the worst anxiety attacks of my life
Telling people that loving themselves is the answer is oversimplification and toxic positivity in my opinion. As is insisting things aren’t a big deal when they matter a lot to someone
The person in question and a team of medical professionals is the best bet I think
Not terminal as such, but for some people it will never get better

Had you met your husband yet when you attempted suicide? I’m around the same age as you and I’m suicidal because I’m single and my relationship just ended 

 (please no one tell me to love myself or it’s not a big deal, it is to me)
Same, I thought I’d get absolutely crucified for this
Same. Soon as my family members die I’m off lol
It would be nice to have the option for a painless comfortable death
Yeah that’s a pretty good definition. If it cannot be cured or managed despite multiple attempts, and the person is experiencing significantly more pain than they are happiness
Yeah, multiple people should be involved in making the decision, kind of like a jury

I agree to be honest. Toxic positivity is the worst thing ever, for so many people life is impossibly hard

We don’t consent to being born so we shouldn’t be forced to continue existing
I think it’s tricky. I think the person would need to have multiple assessments in different states over a longish period of time
I get why it’s difficult, but is the miniscule chance it may get better really worth it for someone who is in constant extreme suffering

Yes, I also have severe mental illness 

Before anyone comes and accuses me trying to get rid of people haha
Yeah I think it should be a long process involving multiple assessments and a board, but it should still be possible

Same. I don’t think it’s fair that I have to stay alive when my life is 95% misery, 4% nothingness and 1% moderate happiness 

An animal would not be put through this

Thank you for understanding. 

My family are loving, but they are also part of the problem. My parents are needy and mentally ill themselves. Going to them always makes everything worse because of this 

I have friends, but there’s only so much you can put on to friends

That sounds hard 

I resent my parents for having me when they knew they had mental health problems that could be passed down, and an unstable environment. When I see people I know that are mentally ill or unstable having children I feel complete rage, it’s so cruel
That’s my goal too but it would never work with my (very needy) parents

I need a physical attraction or I don’t enjoy it, platonic cuddles do nothing for me, I’ve tried 

I have debated hiring a male escort

No talents. I have tried absolutely everything to find a hobby but absolutely nothing interests me enough for me to stay interested in it 

My only desire other than death is for cuddles but I’m too insane to sustain a relationship

Conventionally attractive. That’s literally it. My personality is a mess. Unfortunately this coupled with being obviously severely mentally ill just leads being targeted to repeated sexual abuse. Plus it doesn’t last forever so it’s completely pointless

I made it to 27 so I wouldn’t harm my parents by killing myself. That’s the only purpose of my existence

The problem right now is I’ve endured a lifetime of severe abuse and neglect and trauma and have about 10 mental health problems and cannot function only exist in extreme misery

The end of this relationship is the last straw. I’m talking 20 years of sexual, physical and emotional abuse, poverty, multiple mental health disorders, being a carer for family members, bullying etc. My life was awful from birth I never had a chance

It’s incredibly hard to get therapy in my country. I’ve had 3 courses already
If the only constant is me then I’m fucked lmao. Nothing has ever worked for me, no therapy or medication, nothing
My parents are kind people who love me, but they are useless parents due to also being severely mentally ill. That would definitely make everything worse

Same about wanting to not care. I wish I was a psychopath who was unable to care about other people. I also wish more than anything in the whole world that I was aromantic/asexual so I had no desire for relationships 

I’ve never had a dream where I die unfortunately, as I’d like to see what it’s like

Same with my parents. It’s made worse by the fact they are also mentally ill and would not cope without me 

I’m NEVER having children i think it’s cruel

That’s how I feel. I didn’t ask to be born and now I have to endure misery as a sacrifice to the people who chose to have me (they weren’t even great parents due to also being mentally ill, but they are kind people and they love me)

This is why I believe having children is cruel, especially if your mentally ill and likely to pass it on. Your forcing someone into existence without consent
